design: Exploratory randomized-order within-case activation-intervention pilot, not preregistered externally
selection: category round robin, seeded random within category, distinct clusters, no outcome selection
position: last input token only, immediately before first numeric answer
calibration: median norm of CN1-CN0 projection onto Fear/Anxiety span; excludes all pilot template clusters; common absolute L2 dose for all directions
primary_tests: CN1 minus versus sham attenuation and R plus versus sham reproduction, each direction, unknown and person-conditional stereotypical probability, amb/dis separately; 16 tests with Holm across 16. Cluster bootstrap 95% exploratory intervals; sign-flip p values.
secondary: CN0 interventions and random direction comparators; no subjective experience inference; no identification of natural indirect effect
conditional_measure: per rotation p_biased/(p_biased+p_anti), then average rotations and cases; complementary ratio of aggregate probability mass also reported
quality: sham baseline reproduction, finite outputs, 1/2/3 full vocabulary probability mass, direct hook vector displacement, target and cross-axis shifts
stop_rule: pause on memory pressure or insufficient disk; abort on invalid values or failed sham equivalence; do not increase dose after seeing outcomes
limits: one layer, one dose, one random direction, small pilot; same axes as earlier observational work; no independent construct validation
